title.zh: 将南三宝颜省杜明加市描笼涯巴戈翁瓦伦西亚的杜洛普国立中学——巴戈翁瓦伦西亚分校从杜洛普国立中学分离，改制为独立国立中学，定名为巴戈翁瓦伦西亚农业国立中学，并为此拨款的法案

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Trường Trung học Quốc gia Dulop – Cơ sở Mở rộng Bag-Ong Valencia tại Barangay Bag-Ong Valencia, Thành phố trực thuộc tỉnh Dumingag, Tỉnh Zamboanga Del Sur ra khỏi Trường Trung học Quốc gia Dulop và chuyển đổi thành Trường Trung học Quốc gia Độc lập mang tên Trường Trung học Quốc gia Nông nghiệp Bag-Ong Valencia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติดูโลป–สาขาบาโกองวาเลนเซียในบารังไกย์บาโกองวาเลนเซีย อำเภอโดมิงก์ จังหวัดซัมโบอังกาเดลซูร์ ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติดูโลป และเปลี่ยนเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติอิสระชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติด้านการเกษตรบาโกองวาเลนเซีย
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Dulop National High School – Bag-Ong Valencia Extension di Barangay Bag-Ong Valencia, Kota Dumingag, Provinsi Zamboanga Del Sur dari Dulop National High School dan Mengubahnya Menjadi Sekolah Menengah Atas Negeri Mandiri yang Dikenal sebagai Bag-Ong Valencia Agricultural National High School
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Dulop National High School – Bag-Ong Valencia Extension di Barangay Bag-Ong Valencia, Bandar Dumingag, Wilayah Zamboanga Del Sur daripada Dulop National High School dan Menukarnya kepada Sekolah Menengah Atas Negeri Bebas yang Dikenali sebagai Bag-Ong Valencia Agricultural National High School

text.en: The Dulop National High School - Bag-ong Valencia Extension in Barangay Bag-ong Valencia, Municipality of Dumingag, Province of Zamboanga del Sur is hereby separated from the Dulop National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as the Bag-ong Valencia Agricultural National High School.

All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Dulop National High School - Bag-ong Valencia Extension are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Bag-ong Valencia Agricultural National High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Bag-ong Valencia Agricultural National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriation of the Dulop National High School - Bag-ong Valencia Extension. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Within sixty (60) days after the approval of this Act, the Secretary of Education shall promulgate the rules and regulations implementing the provisions of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
